newsitem.title: TURKEY: Perry to visit Turkey for Iraq talks on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Perry to visit Turkey for Iraq talks on Monday.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry is due in Ankara on Monday for consultations with NATO ally Turkey on the Iraq crisis, Turkish officials said on Sunday.
"Our defence minister will meet him arriving at the airport at 0830 (0530 GMT) tomorrow," a defence ministry spokesman said. The foreign ministry confirmed the time of his arrival.
The U.S. embassy withdrew an earlier comment that Perry, on a Middle East tour to shore up the Gulf War coalition that ended Baghdad's 1990-91 occupation of Kuwait, would arrive in Turkey on Sunday.
In Kuwait earlier on Sunday, Perry warned that further U.S. strikes on Iraq were still a possibility.
Asked whether more U.S. raids on Iraq were still possible, he told a news conference: "Yes, it is still a possibility."

Turkey hosts a U.S.-led allied air force that patrols a no-fly zone over northern Iraq. Iraqi forces fired at U.S. jets last week, prompting Washington to send more planes and warships to the region for a possible attack on Iraq.
